resources.string: Type a message below or try one of these:
Explain what MVVM is in Android
Give me ideas for a mobile app
Summarize in 3 bullets what Firebase is
Write a haiku about coding at night
Firebase is not set up. Add app/google-services.json (see the README) and run the app again.
No connection, or the request took too long. Check your internet and try again.
The free usage limit of the model was reached. Wait a moment and try again.
The Firebase project is not set up correctly: the Gemini API may be disabled, or the key was rejected. See the README.
The model did not answer because the safety filter blocked the message or the reply. Try rephrasing.
This app did not pass the App Check verification. If this is a debug build, register its token (see the README).
The model is not available in your region.
The reply was cut off when the app was closed.
Something went wrong and there is no reply. Try again.
The current conversation will be cleared.
A chatbot that talks to the Gemini generative AI model through Firebase AI Logic. Made for the Mobile App Development course.
